title: Spinner
summary: The standard spinner. Inside a Monarch theme it takes the accent colour from the tint. Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: For a short wait of unknown length.
whenNotToUse: When the fraction is known, use the linear style.
appearance: System spinner, tinted with the accent of the theme.
platformNotes: The parity plan lists this as a style on MonarchProgressViewStyle. Today the circular form is the untouched system ProgressView with the theme's tint, so it is recorded here as native adoption.
accessibility: System behaviour: exposed as a progress indicator. Add accessibilityLabel when no visible text says what is loading.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.code:
HStack(spacing: 16) {
    ProgressView()
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchSpinner)
        .controlSize(.small)
        .accessibilityLabel("Loading small")
    ProgressView()
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchSpinner)
        .controlSize(.regular)
        .accessibilityLabel("Loading")
    ProgressView()
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchSpinner)
        .controlSize(.large)
        .accessibilityLabel("Loading large")
}

parityExceptions.reason: Naming only: the web size is written as the system ProgressView controlSize (small, regular, large); the spinner shown is the same.
